paper_title: Electrochemical Access to Aza-Polycyclic Aromatic Hydrocarbons: Rhoda-Electrocatalyzed Domino Alkyne Annulations
source_file: /home/wzfeng/MySearch/PhotoRag/MD/Angew Chem Int Ed - 2019 - Kong - Electrochemical Access to Aza‐Polycyclic Aromatic Hydrocarbons  Rhoda‐Electrocatalyzed/auto/Angew Chem Int Ed - 2019 - Kong - Electrochemical Access to Aza‐Polycyclic Aromatic Hydrocarbons  Rhoda‐Electrocatalyzed.md

knowledge_points.content: Aza-polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (aza-PAHs) are synthesized via a rhoda-electrocatalyzed domino alkyne annulation using a multifunctional o-methylamidoxime directing group.
knowledge_points.evidence: Herein, a modular electrochemical synthesis of azaPAHs was developed via a rhodium-catalyzed cascade C-H activation and alkyne annulation. A multifunctional o-methylamidoxime enabled the high chemo- and regioselectivity.

knowledge_points.content: The optimal electrochemical conditions for the synthesis of aza-PAH 3aa include using [Cp*Rh(CH3CN)3](SbF6)2 as the catalyst, KOAc as the base, 1-adamantanecarboxylic acid (AdOH) as an additive, and methanol as the solvent in an undivided cell with a 2.0 mA constant current.
knowledge_points.evidence: Cationic rhodium catalyst [Cp*Rh(CH3CN)3](SbF6)2 further improved the efficacy, affording product 3aa in 90% yield at 35 °C... with MeOH as the solvent and a constant current of 4.0 mA... AdOH giving the best results... lowering the applied current to 2.0 mA increased the yield to 75%.

knowledge_points.content: The rhoda-electrocatalyzed cascade C-H activation process tolerates highly reactive functional groups, specifically iodo and azido groups, which are typically sensitive to electrochemical conditions.
knowledge_points.evidence: Notably, the highly sensitive iodo substituent was well tolerated under the electrochemical conditions... Surprisingly, the highly functional azide group was well tolerated in this metalla-electrocatalysis (3ai).

knowledge_points.content: The electrochemical synthesis is performed in an undivided cell utilizing a graphite felt (GF) anode and a platinum (Pt) plate cathode.
knowledge_points.evidence: Undivided cell, graphite felt anode (GF) (70 x 75 x 6 mm^3), platinum plate cathode (Pt) (10 x 15 x 0.25 mm^3).

knowledge_points.content: Cyclic voltammetry of a key rhodacycle intermediate (complex 5) in the presence of alkyne 2b revealed a low oxidation peak at 0.23 V vs. ferrocene, suggesting an anodic oxidation-induced reductive elimination pathway.
knowledge_points.evidence: In addition, when cyclic voltammetry studies of 5 in the presence of alkyne 2b were conducted, a low oxidation peak at 0.23 V vs. ferrocene implied that an oxidatively induced reductive elimination pathway was involved.

knowledge_points.content: Cationic nitrogen-doped nanographene 6 exhibits reversible redox behavior with its radical form at a low potential of E1/2 = -1.72 V vs. ferrocene.
knowledge_points.evidence: Treating aza-PAH 3aa with iodomethane afforded a cationic nitrogen-doped nanographene 6 in 93% yield... which showed reversible redox behavior with its radical form at a low potential of E1/2 = -1.72 V vs. ferrocene.

knowledge_points.content: Prolonged electrolysis or high applied potential in the rhoda-electrocatalyzed annulation can lead to product decomposition or undesired side reactions, as evidenced by lower yields at 4.0 mA compared to 2.0 mA.
knowledge_points.evidence: The reaction gave a higher yield at a shorter reaction time, indicating that a high potential and prolonged electrolysis may lead to undesired side reactions or product decomposition... lowering the applied current to 2.0 mA increased the yield to 75% with a prolonged reaction time.

knowledge_points.content: Aza-PAH 3aj, which contains six pendant azide groups, can be converted into a dendrimer with a hydrophobic core and hydrophilic periphery (8) via an azide-alkyne Huisgen cycloaddition with a yield of 88%.
knowledge_points.evidence: Intrigued by the six pendant azide groups on 3aj, we performed an azide-alkyne Huisgen cycloaddition reaction... Thus, a dendrimer with hydrophobic core and hydrophilic periphery 8 was assembled in high yield (88%).

knowledge_points.content: The rhoda-electrocatalyzed cascade C-H activation is scalable to a gram-scale synthesis, producing 1.11 g of aza-PAH 3aa (76% yield) using a 12.0 mA constant current.
knowledge_points.evidence: Hence, the gram-scale synthesis of product 3aa was realized with a reduced amount of the rhodium catalyst under a constant current of 12.0 mA... 1a (2.0 mmol), 2a (7.0 mmol) -> 3aa, 1.11 g, 76%.

knowledge_points.content: The synthesis of aza-PAHs involves a threefold C-H activation and the formation of six new bonds (four C-C and two C-N bonds) in a single step.
knowledge_points.evidence: Salient features of this electrocatalytic transformation include... three C-H bonds activated and six new bonds formed.
